headline: DPM DRILLS 713 METRES AT 2.52 g/t AuEq — Major Porphyry Find Next Door to Chelopech
snippet: DPM Metals hit 713m grading 2.52 g/t AuEq (1.31 g/t Au, 1.16% Cu) at its Brevene South Porphyry target in Bulgaria — just 1 km from the Chelopech mine concession. The company calls it a fourth major discovery since 2023 and plans to file for a Commercial Discovery Certificate when the current phase ends in September.

headline: 49 METALS HITS PROJECT-RECORD GRADE: 9.1m at 21.9 g/t Signals Feeder Zone at Gold Mountain
snippet: ASX-listed 49 Metals (49M) returned a project-record 27.4m at 8.3 g/t gold, including 9.1m at 21.9 g/t, at Gold Mountain Nevada — the highest grade-thickness in 48 years of exploration at the site. Management believes hole DRC#9 cut the structural feeder zone feeding the broader epithermal system. Assays for four more holes are pending.

headline: LAC GOLD ASSAYS 1,580 g/t AT ASTORIA — Phase 2 Drill Already Turning in Quebec
snippet: Lac Gold (ASX:LAC) returned 5.65m at 141.29 g/t gold at the Astoria deposit in Quebec's Rouyn gold camp, with a half-metre slice assaying an extraordinary 1,580 g/t. Phase 1 drilling of 15,000m is now complete and Phase 2 has already started with two diamond rigs running; a stack of assays remains pending.

headline: GOLD HOLDS $4,462 THIS MORNING — Rally Capped as Labor Data Kills Rate-Cut Hopes
snippet: Gold is trading at $4,462–$4,496 early Thursday, bouncing modestly after Wednesday's slide below $4,500. Stronger-than-expected US labor data is reinforcing higher-for-longer rate expectations — gold's near-term ceiling — while the US-Iran standoff and Israel-Hezbollah fighting sustain underlying safe-haven demand.

headline: CENTRAL ASIA METALS BIDS A$232M FOR CYGNUS — 60% Premium for Chibougamau Copper-Gold
snippet: London-listed Central Asia Metals (CAML) proposed an all-scrip acquisition of ASX-listed Cygnus Metals (CY5) at A$232 million — a 60% premium to last close. The strategic prize is Cygnus's Chibougamau copper-gold project in Quebec. The Cygnus board unanimously recommended the deal; shareholders controlling ~29% have already flagged support.

headline: TRUMP TWEAKS COPPER TARIFF THRESHOLDS — June 30 Refined Metal Review Is the Real Deadline
snippet: A June 2 White House fact sheet updated copper tariff rules — lowering the US-content threshold from 95% to 85% and expanding product coverage to certain conductors and cables. The bigger watch item: Commerce Secretary Lutnick must report to Trump on the domestic copper market by June 30, which could trigger new duties on refined copper imports from 2027.

headline: URANIUM SPOT JUMPS 3.5% TO $86/lb — AI Data Centre Demand Thesis Gains Steam
snippet: Uranium spot surged 3.48% on June 3 to $86.25/lb, building on its recovery from the February selloff triggered by the Iran war. AI data centre electricity demand is now alongside long-term utility contracting as a structural demand driver, with analysts projecting the supply deficit to widen materially through the decade.

headline: CATL: ENERGY STORAGE WILL BE 50% OF GLOBAL SALES BY 2030 — Up from 25% Today
snippet: CATL's European energy storage director said the company expects grid-scale storage to grow from 25% of global battery sales to 50% by 2030 — up from just 2% five years ago. The forecast reinforces the structural lithium demand case as lithium demand for storage is already expected to grow 55% in 2026 following a 71% jump in 2025.

headline: GOLD MINERS AT RECORD MARGINS — Analysts Say the Long-Overdue Re-Rating Has Arrived
snippet: With industry-wide all-in sustaining costs below $2,000/oz against a $4,462 gold price, senior miners are generating record free cash flow yet still trade at depressed multiples versus their historical averages. Multiple analysts are calling for a sector re-rating as investor flows rotate from bullion ETFs back to equities — GDX gained ~35% while gold rose 60%+.

headline: GOLD-SILVER RATIO CONTRACTS FROM 105: History Suggests Silver Outperformance Dead Ahead
snippet: The gold-to-silver ratio peaked above 105 in April and has since begun contracting — a historically reliable setup for sharp silver outperformance. Technical analysts note GDX broke out of a multi-year triangle stretching back to 2011, while silver miners (SIL ETF) still need a decisive close above the $48–$52 resistance zone to confirm the bull trend.
